tools.name: set_merchandising_rule_enabled
tools.description: MODIFIES DATA. Enables or disables one merchandising rule while preserving its schedule and configuration. Use only when the caller's intent is to change the rule. Read the current rule with get_merchandising_rule first when its state is unknown.

datasetId.description: Dataset ID to target. If unknown, use get_me to discover it. If ambiguous, ask the user. Do not guess.

enabled.description: True to enable the rule or false to disable it.

found.description: Whether a merchandising rule with the requested ID was found.

rule.description: Updated rule details when found; otherwise null.

configuration.description: Type-specific rule configuration. The type discriminator selects one documented configuration variant.

anyOf.description: Configuration for a rule that boosts or buries matching entities.

multiplier.description: Selector that determines the multiplier applied to matching entities.

anyOf.description: A constant multiplier applied to every entity matched by the rule.

value.description: Constant multiplier value. Values above one boost and values between zero and one bury matching entities.

key.description: Case-sensitive data key containing the multiplier value.

anyOf.description: Configuration for a rule that places matching entities at a fixed result position.

position.description: One-based result position assigned to matching entities.

modified.description: UTC date and time when the merchandising rule was last modified.
